Name: Launchable Items
Author: AqueleCass
Description:
[heading]Description[/heading]
Launchable Items adds new ways to interact with the world of Stardew Valley by allowing you to throw various items and use them in creative ways.
Throw bombs at your targets, launch daggers that return to your hand, toss torches to light up the ground, plant seeds while walking, and even deliver gifts by throwing them at villagers!
The mod also introduces new mechanics, such as bomb fishing, customizable throwing distances, directional fishing rod aiming, and the ability to throw items directly into chests and machines.
Most features can be customized through the configuration menu, allowing you to adjust the experience to your liking.
[b]Note:[/b] Regular farming tools, such as axes, pickaxes, and hoes, cannot be thrown. The mod focuses on specific items and interactions to preserve game balance.
[heading]Installation Instructions[/heading]
[list=1]
[*]Install SMAPI if you haven't already.[/*]
[*]Download Launchable Items.[/*]
[*]Extract the mod folder into your Stardew Valley
[code]Mods[/code]folder.[/*]
[*]Launch Stardew Valley through SMAPI.[/*]
[/list]The configuration file will be automatically generated after the first launch.
You can also install Generic Mod Config Menu to configure the mod directly through the in-game menu.
[heading]Main Features[/heading]
Bombs
Throw Cherry Bombs, Bombs, and Mega Bombs in the direction of your cursor.
[list]
[*]Customizable throwing distance for each bomb type.[/*]
[*]Trajectory preview showing the expected landing location.[/*]
[*]Visual indicators for valid and invalid landing locations.[/*]
[*]Bombs can collide with monsters and knock them back.[/*]
[*]Bombs can sink and explode underwater.[/*]
[*]Different bombs produce different explosion effects.[/*]
[/list]Daggers
Turn daggers into throwable weapons and take combat to a whole new level!
[list]
[*]Hold the throwing key to charge your throw.[/*]
[*]Throw daggers at enemies from a distance.[/*]
[*]Daggers damage monsters on both the outgoing and returning paths.[/*]
[*]The dagger automatically returns to your hand, letting you attack enemies by throwing and pulling it back.[/*]
[*]Throwing distance increases with charging time.[/*]
[*]Customizable maximum throwing distance.[/*]
[/list]Torches
Throw torches to illuminate your surroundings!
[list]
[*]Throw torches in the direction of your cursor.[/*]
[*]Torches remain on the ground and stay lit after landing.[/*]
[*]Customizable throwing distance.[/*]
[*]Torches cannot land in water.[/*]
[/list]Plant Seeds While Walking
Plant seeds without stopping to manually plant each tile!
[list]
[*]Hold the throwing key while walking with seeds equipped.[/*]
[*]Seeds are automatically planted on empty tilled soil along your path.[/*]
[*]Respects normal planting restrictions, including seasons and locations.[/*]
[/list]Bomb Fishing
Use bombs to catch fish in a completely different way!
[list]
[*]Explosions send fish flying out of the water and onto nearby land.[/*]
[*]Different bomb types produce different numbers and qualities of fish.[/*]
[*]Cherry Bombs, Bombs, and Mega Bombs have different fishing yields.[/*]
[*]Fish have a configurable chance to be smoked, set to 25% by default.[/*]
[*]Fish are dropped on the ground instead of going directly into your inventory.[/*]
[*]Water gradually recovers after being affected by explosions.[/*]
[*]Water depletion reduces fishing yields, but never completely prevents you from catching fish.[/*]
[*]Explosion effects become larger and more dramatic depending on the bomb used.[/*]
[/list]Fishing Rod Aiming
Reach fishing spots that would normally be difficult or impossible to access!
[list]
[*]A visual aiming indicator shows the intended landing location.[/*]
[*]Aim using your cursor.[/*]
[*]Cast in any direction, including diagonally.[/*]
[*]Reach unusual fishing spots by casting diagonally around obstacles or into areas that normal casting directions cannot reach.[/*]
[*]Visual indicators show whether the selected location is water or land.[/*]
[*]Customizable casting distance.[/*]
[*]Can be disabled to restore the normal fishing rod behavior.[/*]
[/list]Throw Gifts at Villagers
Why walk up to someone when you can throw them a present?
[list]
[*]Throw items directly at villagers to give them gifts.[/*]
[*]Uses the game's normal gift system, respecting preferences, birthdays, daily gift limits, and quests.[/*]
[*]Each supported villager has three unique reactions to receiving thrown gifts.[/*]
[*]Includes support for Stardew Valley Expanded characters.[/*]
[*]Special reactions are also available for characters such as Krobus, Mr. Qi, and Willy.[/*]
[/list]Throw Items Into Chests and Machines
Throw items directly into different storage and processing objects!
[list]
[*]Throw items into chests and mini-shipping bins.[/*]
[*]Insert items into machines such as furnaces, kegs, preserves jars, crab pots, fish tanks, and other supported objects.[/*]
[*]Support for the farm shipping bin and hay hoppers.[/*]
[*]Option to throw an entire stack instead of one item at a time.[/*]
[*]Machines only accept the items they normally process.[/*]
[*]Full chests return the thrown item instead of consuming it.[/*]
[*]Items that miss their targets fall to the ground instead of disappearing.[/*]
[*]Support for delivering items to other players in multiplayer.[/*]
[/list]Customizable Throwing System
[list]
[*]Configurable throwing keys.[/*]
[*]Adjustable throwing distances.[/*]
[*]Customizable dagger charging distance.[/*]
[*]Adjustable bomb fishing settings.[/*]
[*]Configurable water depletion and recovery.[/*]
[*]Options to enable or disable individual mechanics.[/*]
[*]Additional settings for fishing rod aiming and throwing behavior.[/*]
[/list][heading]Requirements[/heading]
[b]Required:[/b]
[list]
[*]Stardew Valley 1.6.15 or later.[/*]
[*]SMAPI 4.1.8 or later.[/*]
[/list][b]Optional:[/b]
[list]
[*]Generic Mod Config Menu: Allows you to configure the mod through the in-game menu.[/*]
[*]Stardew Valley Expanded: Supported for additional character dialogue and compatibility.[/*]
[/list]Neither Generic Mod Config Menu nor Stardew Valley Expanded is required for the mod to function.
[heading]Languages[/heading]
The mod includes translations for:
[list]
[*]English[/*]
[*]Brazilian Portuguese[/*]
[*]Spanish[/*]
[*]French[/*]
[*]Chinese[/*]
[/list]The language automatically follows your game's language settings.
[heading]Shout Outs[/heading]
